facts.label: English
facts.value: The Emperor's Private Apartments (Nine Continents Clear and Calm)

facts.label: Built
facts.value: 最早建筑清晖阁 康熙四十六年 1707 (S42); name under Yongzheng (S42)

facts.label: Changed
facts.value: 1765 四景 added (S05); 1831 慎德堂, 乐安和/怡情书史 removed (S41; S43); 1836 fire on the central axis, 3 halls rebuilt (S41; S54); 1837 同道堂 (S43); 1855 theatre (S43)

facts.label: Note
facts.value: S42: 东西长220 m, 南北宽120 m, 占地25000 m2, 建筑面积8600 m2, 殿宇游廊656间. Rixia spells 九州清宴. Plan readers: the 1860 state of the west road is the Daoguang one. Album does not show the 1860 state here (S41).
